title: Sound pulse in a duct
line: A transient acoustic FEA study of a pressure pulse traveling down a 1 m air duct.
description: A Gaussian pressure pulse (1 Pa peak, 0.25 ms wide), generated by the MATLAB function gaussianPulse.m, drives one end of a 1 m air duct with a 100 mm square section; the far end is anechoic. The study records the pressure at both ends; the pulse peak arrives L / c = 2.92 ms after it leaves.
thumbnailAlt: Sound pulse traveling down an air duct, solved in RunMat
